notes.title: Game update
notes.content: [p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895671/1df6781326eb8d95854cdb0b910155958cbb87eb.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895671/1758ae4305d8b63bd88547d448302fa7a018a8f2.jpg"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]Here's a new note for the game and its page: [/p][p]Our dev has lost all files in connection with the project, leading to the poor state of the game and its prospective expandability. This might be the nail in the coffin for our presence here. If you do decide to acquire a copy, please be aware that it might not ever be updated and please also know that you will be one of our heroes forever.[/p][p][b]Peace of mind[/b] can only be reached when you accept the things you cannot change and find the courage to change the things you can.[/p]

notes.title: Private beta test
notes.content:
Mortalis Meltdown private beta testing is about to commence.

Please send us an email with your specs, your country and mention if you are comfortable with streaming your play session with the team.

Thank you.
